title: Minnesota Vikings vs. Detroit Lions Postgame Analysis: What Happened, What We Got Right and What We Learned
seo_title: Minnesota Vikings 15-19 Detroit Lions: EdgeDesk Postgame Thesis Audit
excerpt: Detroit Lions won 19-15. THE NUMBER LANDED AND THE REASONING DID NOT. This is the most dangerous result on this page, because it pays and teaches nothing. Nothing below should be read as EdgeDesk having understood this game.
seo_description: Detroit Lions beat Minnesota Vikings 19-15. EdgeDesk’s number implied Detroit Lions +4.5 — win. 3 of 11 gradeable claims held up, 7 did not. Process grade: UNSOUND. Research, not picks.
